name: Handwheel-operation qualifier
summary: A handwheel qualifier identifies an operating mechanism moved by a wheel.
description: A handwheel qualifier identifies an operating mechanism moved by a wheel. A handwheel can change a mechanism position or adjust an associated element. The qualifier describes that manual interface, not a particular electrical output characteristic.
For an adjustment function, identify the controlled quantity and any position indication separately. For switching, retain the contact diagram and position table.
readingNotes: Keep the wheel indication tied to the operated mechanism and its position description.
A wheel-actuated device can regulate or switch; the associated function must be stated.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Keep the wheel indication tied to the operated mechanism and its position description.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A wheel-actuated device can regulate or switch; the associated function must be stated.
